subject: Learning Methods
title: Monitoring Your Comprehension
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Monitoring Your Comprehension.

hook.text: He read twenty pages and felt confident. A quick self-test revealed he understood nothing.

buildup.text: Comprehension monitoring means checking your understanding as you read, not just at the end.

discovery.text: Stop every few paragraphs and ask: can I explain what I just read? If not, reread before moving forward.

twist.text: Fluent reading creates a dangerous illusion. The words flow smoothly so your brain assumes understanding is happening.

climax.text: Build a checkpoint habit: every page or section, pause and verbalize the key idea. Catch confusion early.

punchline.text: Check understanding every page. Catch confusion early.

quiz.question: Why does fluent reading sometimes create an illusion of comprehension?
options: Smooth word flow makes the brain assume understanding is happening
Fluent readers always have strong background knowledge
